name: Vertical Jump Practice
setup: Stand tall on flat ground with room to swing your arms.
execution: Jump as high as you can, swinging the arms, then land under control. The video recommends practicing the vertical jump movement to train contracting everything rapidly.
cues: Chain the system together so the jump is less awkward and more athletic
why: Practice trains fast contraction of glutes and quads; more force in less time before takeoff means a higher jump.

name: Standing Broad Jump
setup: Stand tall on flat ground with room to jump forward and land.
execution: Jump forward as far as possible, propelling yourself at roughly a 45-degree angle with an arm swing, and land under control.
cues: Drive from the glutes, which pull you laterally
why: Broad and vertical jump are insanely related; practicing one prepares you about 90% for the other. Landing is harder in the broad jump because you must stick it.
